## Why visit

The dramatic railway viaduct setting and several small drinking rooms make this one of Stockport’s most characteristic pub stops. Its recent history matters: older accounts of decline are no longer the whole picture. CAMRA records an August 2025 reopening under the Petersgate Tap team and names it the branch’s Most Improved Pub in 2026. The attraction is the combination of renewed independent cask selection and surviving intimate rooms with old seating and bell pushes. Pair it with the Magnet for beer range, or the Swan with Two Necks for a comparison of local pub layouts.

## Beer

Current CAMRA description records free-of-tie handpumps, smaller breweries and Draught Bass among the normal offering.

## Plan the visit

Reopened 15 August 2025; latest CAMRA record updated October 2026. Usually closed Mondays, with listed exceptions; verify.

**Getting there:** Heaton Lane beneath the viaduct; useful link between central Stockport and the Magnet.
